citadel.name: Citadel
citadel.description: Double concentric orbital rings with 8 inner and 12 mid deflector pegs.

pachinko.name: Pachinko Pinfield
pachinko.description: Dense hexagonal deflection lattice providing randomized ricochets towards the singularity.

crossfire.name: Crossfire Arena
crossfire.description: 4 massive corner super-bumpers (+15% bounce) with orthogonal corridor choke-points.

bullseye_funnel.name: Bullseye Funnel
bullseye_funnel.description: Dual segmented security rings with 4 cardinal entry gates at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees.

closest.name: Closest to Singularity (Curling/Shuffleboard)
closest.description: Standard competition where combatants vie for closest millimeter proximity to the center [0,0].

koth.name: King of the Hill (KOTH)
koth.description: Territory control. A circular zone of radius 75 units continuously accrues points for the team with dominant presence.

most_hits.name: Most Hits Time Attack
most_hits.description: Combatants have 90 seconds to trigger maximum peg deflections and puck collisions.

24h_colosseum.name: 24-Hour Colosseum (Persistent Epoch)
24h_colosseum.description: Persistent asynchronous multiplayer arena where pucks remain settled on the ice for 24 hours.

24h_barrage.name: 24-Hour Barrage
24h_barrage.description: Mass synchronized salvo arena where combatants commit shots for simultaneous release.

closest_single.name: CLOSEST PUCK
closest_single.description: The combatant or team with the single nearest puck to the center [0,0] claims victory.

player_best_avg.name: PLAYER BEST AVG
player_best_avg.description: Scores are determined by averaging each player's top-performing puck.

all_pucks_avg.name: ALL PUCKS AVG
all_pucks_avg.description: Team score is the arithmetic mean distance of all placed pucks.

all_pucks_total.name: ALL PUCKS TOTAL
all_pucks_total.description: Cumulative aggregate distance of all placed pucks. Lowest total wins.
